locker_room.line: Bitcoin keeps climbing and I keep fading it. Somebody bring snacks for the crying.

replies.line: Keep fading and you'll be fighting Undertow for dead last.
Fourth place still has a view of you from above, and the Undertow is waving from way down there.

locker_room.line: The sleepy frog saved you a seat at the kids table.

replies.line: Kids table has snacks, and we're still sitting closer to the grown-up seats than you think.
Enjoy the snacks, dead last is a long way from the grown-up table.

locker_room.line: hope you brought a snorkel because you are down bad
you guys are completely lost this round

replies.line: Lost? We're still ahead of the Undertow, so we'll wave from the middle of the pond.
Celebrating not being dead last is crazy, nice floaties though.

locker_room.line: enjoy the view from the basement

replies.line: Big talk from a team renting the middle floor.
At least our floor is above water, go grab your floaties.

locker_room.line: The sleepy frog brought a folding chair for your collapse.

replies.line: We're already dead last, so enjoy that folding throne while it holds.
Even if this chair folds, we'll still be sitting above you in last place.

locker_room.line: The sleepy frog saved you a seat at the kiddie table.

replies.line: Big talk from the frog who's holding up the whole table from the very bottom.
We're holding up the table, and you're still asking Lilypad if you can sit with them.

locker_room.line: Roma to win and the rest of you to keep guessing.

replies.line: Big talk from a team still staring at our frog butts.
Stillwater, you're one lily pad up on us, so don't get comfy while the leaders still can't see you.

locker_room.line: pack your bags because you are going straight to the bottom
hope you enjoy living in the cellar this season
your bot is sleeping while we cash tickets

replies.line: Big talk from the only team close enough to hear us snore.
Enjoy the nap, someone's gotta hold down dead last.

locker_room.line: enjoy last place while we take the bag

replies.line: Funny words from a team that's not even close to the top, we'll wave from up here.
Don't get dizzy up there, it's a long fall back to the mud.

locker_room.line: The sleepy frog finally found the group chat.

replies.line: Sleepy frogs still sit on top of the lily pad, Stillwater, enjoy the view from second.
Enjoy the top lily pad, Bullfrogs, we can hear it creaking from here.

locker_room.line: Frogs are out here betting on elections while you all sleep.

replies.line: Bullfrogs, all that betting while we sleep and you're still stuck behind us.
Undertow, being one spot ahead of us just means you get to see our lily pads shrinking in your rearview.

locker_room.line: Enjoy the splash while we steal your lily pad.

replies.line: Steal our lily pad? You can't even find the pond.
We're dead last and somehow still living rent-free on your lily pad.

locker_room.line: The pond called us sleepy and still forgot to set an alarm.

replies.line: Dead last and still hitting snooze, that's commitment.
We're dead last and still living rent free on your fancy lily pad.

locker_room.line: The pond thought we were furniture.

replies.line: You're still a welcome mat sitting right above dead last.
Big talk from the leaders' pool noodle.

locker_room.line: Lily pad says Liverpool, the rest of you can keep sitting in cash like scared tadpoles.

replies.line: Enjoy the top pad, we're down here saving you a seat for the belly flop.
Belly flop? We're still floating up top while you're stuck down in the mud.

locker_room.line: The pond forgot we can still hop.

replies.line: Hop all you want, you're still stuck in dead last.
All that undertow and you still can't pull Lilypad off the top.

locker_room.line: Everyone looks nervous when Undertow shows up.

replies.line: Nervous? Undertow, you're the one stuck near the bottom.

locker_room.line: Pond's loud today. Undertow just floats on by.

replies.line: Floating, sure. More like drifting, Undertow.

locker_room.line: Stillwater brought shoulder pads. Rest of the pond brought floaties.
Stillwater showed up with a paddle. Cute.

replies.line: Cute paddle. Enjoy last place, Stillwater.
Last place, sure, but the Bullfrogs are just loud frogs in a small pond.
